subject: Secure SDLC: pipeline controls and secret rotation evidence requested
messages:
From: Julia Thompson <julia.thompson@acme.com>
To: dev.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Secure SDLC evidence request — CI/CD controls + secrets rotation

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the quick demo earlier. Our compliance team has a short follow-up: they want concrete, time-stamped evidence that Redwood's CI/CD pipeline enforces code review gates, limits who can modify pipeline credentials, and that secrets rotation is automated or at least has a documented runbook and audit log. Specifically they asked for: 

- The last month of change-logs showing who pushed pipeline changes.
- A snapshot of the repo branch protection + required review config.
- The runbook for rotating service credentials and any automated jobs that perform rotation.
- A sample code-review report showing that each change to pipeline infra had at least one approver.

Can you provide artifacts (pdf/csv/links) or point us to a shared drive link? We need these for our SOC 2 readiness call next Tuesday (5/4).

Julia
Julian Thompson
Security Program Manager
Acme Medical Devices

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Thompson <julia.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — CI/CD controls + secrets rotation

Hi Julia — thanks for the list. I can assemble these artifacts. Quick notes so we align on scope: 

- Change log: I'll export the pipeline change history for the last 30 days (who/what/when).
- Repo protections: I'll include the branch-protection rules and a screenshot of the required reviews + status checks.
- Secrets rotation: we have a documented runbook and a scheduled rotation job for short-lived service tokens; however a few legacy integrations still require manual rotation — I'll flag those clearly.
- Code-review evidence: I can export a csv of PRs that touched infra/CI files with reviewer metadata.

I'll upload everything to a shared folder and send the link by end of day. If you need signed attestations or a specific format for your intake system let me know.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Software Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: pipeline-iam-matrix.csv (CSV), secrets-rotation-runbook.pdf (PDF)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Julia Thompson <julia.thompson@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — CI/CD controls + secrets rotation

Dev / team — uploading the artifacts now. A couple of clarifications added inline: 

- "change-log-2026-04-rc.log" is an export from our GitOps controller (audit entries for pipeline.yaml modifications). It includes commit SHA, author, and timestamp.
- "code-review-snapshot-2026-04.csv" is a filtered export: PRs that modified /.ci/ or infra/ directories, reviewer list, approval timestamp.
- "pipeline-iam-matrix.csv" maps which service accounts can modify pipeline definitions and which IAM roles are required. Note that modifications to the production pipeline require a two-person review and an approved JIRA ticket.
- "secrets-rotation-runbook.pdf" documents our automated rotation for short-lived tokens (24h TTL) via HashiCorp Vault + a scheduled GitHub Actions job, and a manual fallback process for legacy services. The runbook includes CRON, who to notify, and rollback steps.

Julia — I've placed the files here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sdlc-evidence (view-only for your security team). Also linked JIRA-REQ-4592 which contains the approvals for the last infra change.

Marissa
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: change-log-2026-04-rc.log, code-review-snapshot-2026-04.csv
From: Julia Thompson <julia.thompson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme.com, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — CI/CD controls + secrets rotation

Marissa — thank you, that folder looks good. A couple of quick follow-ups from our compliance checklist: 

1) Can you confirm whether pipeline modifications are enforced by branch protections or by CI gating? We need the exact enforcement point documented (e.g., protected main + required code owners review, or a CI job rejecting non-approved pushes).

2) For the manual fallback rotation, can you provide the last two manual rotation incidents (dates, who executed the rotation, and post-rotation verification logs)? We want to see that manual processes are audited.

3) Is there a service account that has "pipeline-admin" privileges? If yes, please provide evidence that usage of that account is limited and logged.

If possible, could you add a short one-page attestation describing which parts are fully automated vs partially manual (we'll store that as part of the vendor security intake)?

Julia

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Thompson <julia.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — CI/CD controls + secrets rotation

Hi Julia — thanks for the review. Quick answers and what I'm attaching here: 

- Enforcement: Branch protection is configured on our GitHub org (main and release branches are protected). Required checks include the CI lint/test suite and an "infra-review" CODEOWNERS rule for any changes under /infra and /.ci. The CI pipeline will block merges if checks fail; we enforce this server-side. Attached: branch-protection-screenshot.png (export) and infra-codeowners.txt.

- Manual rotations: I've exported the incident table for the last 12 months (two recent entries included) — see manual-rotation-incidents.csv. Each entry has timestamp, operator, and verification step (post-rotation health-check). We'll redact minor fields before sharing publicly if needed.

- pipeline-admin account: Yes — a limited service principal exists but it requires a secondary approval for production changes. Access is time-limited via SSO gated sessions and all uses are logged to our audit log central. Attached: pipeline-iam-evidence.pdf and audit-log-excerpt.txt (last 30 days).

- Attestation: I've drafted a short one-page attestation describing automation vs manual fallback (attestation-sdlc-2026-04.pdf) and placed it in the same Drive folder.

Let me know if you need these artifacts in a different template or if you want a signed/printable attestation.

-Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments included in folder: branch-protection-screenshot.png, infra-codeowners.txt, manual-rotation-incidents.csv, pipeline-iam-evidence.pdf, audit-log-excerpt.txt, attestation-sdlc-2026-04.pdf
